summary: Multi-position tiled acquisition. Required for the Tiling widget.

fields.label: XY Positioner
fields.tip: Stage that moves between tile centres (must match a positioner in the setup).

fields.label: Z Positioner (opt.)
fields.tip: Z positioner used for per-tile autofocus. Leave empty to disable.

fields.label: Align on (opt.)
fields.tip: Detector used for tile alignment. Empty = first forAcquisition detector.

fields.label: Detector transforms
fields.tip: Optional. How each additionally saved detector's pixels relate to the aligned-on one, e.g. {"APD1": "identity"} after confirming pixel registration. Detectors left out are still saved, recorded as 'unknown'.

fields.label: Default tile step (µm)
fields.tip: Default stage step between tile centres, in micrometres.

fields.label: Default tiles X
fields.tip: Default grid width. Equal to Y opens the widget with its square lock on.

fields.label: Default tiles Y
fields.tip: Default grid height.

fields.label: Default pattern
fields.tip: spiral = grows outward from the current position, stoppable early with a centred mosaic. serpentine = rasters from the current position in +X/+Y, no move longer than one tile step.

fields.label: Settle time (ms)
fields.tip: Wait after each stage move before the tile is acquired. Too short and tiles are taken while the stage still rings.

fields.label: Flip mosaic X
fields.tip: Mirror the mosaic along X when the overview builds left/right opposite to the stage movement (camera mounting, stage sign). The stage path is unchanged.

fields.label: Flip mosaic Y
fields.tip: Mirror the mosaic along Y. See Flip mosaic X.

fields.label: Swap mosaic X/Y
fields.tip: Exchange the mosaic's X and Y, for a camera mounted at 90 degrees to the stage axes. Applied before the flips.

fields.label: Acquisition mode
fields.tip: free-running = grab a frame from a continuously running camera at each tile. triggered = run one scan per tile (scanned detectors, or a camera on the scan's trigger).

fields.label: Scan to trigger
fields.tip: Triggered mode: panel key of the scan to run per tile. Empty picks it automatically when the setup has one scan.

fields.label: Scan timeout (s)
fields.tip: Triggered mode: how long one tile's scan may take before the run gives up.

fields.label: Align tiles
fields.tip: Refine each tile's placement by phase correlation against its neighbours instead of trusting the stage position alone.

fields.label: Max alignment shift
fields.tip: Reject alignment corrections larger than this fraction of the tile step (guards against false matches on periodic samples).

fields.label: Save tiles
fields.tip: Save every tile, the stitched mosaic and stitching sidecars (TileConfiguration.txt, tiles.json) as the run proceeds.

fields.label: Save format
fields.tip: TIFF (OME-TIFF, what stitching tools read natively), HDF5 or ZARR (OME-NGFF).

fields.label: Save folder
fields.tip: Base folder for saved tiling runs; each run gets its own <date>/tiling_<time> folder. Empty = the ImSwitch default.
